digest.component_or_area: plan-review blocking gates and T10 infra detection
propositions: T3 and T10 findings must block when priority exceeds 0.90 threshold via default_posture blocking in criteria_routing.json

T10 severity guidance must restrict MAJOR-class findings to destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret, and unauthenticated service categories to prevent lower findings from exceeding priority threshold
T10 DetGateRule with infra-vocabulary trigger (terraform, cloudformation, kubernetes, iam, ec2, github actions, etc.) must gate T10 routing on infrastructure-related plans
Pinned routing table and approved-blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must reflect T3 and T10 as blocking criteria
T10 findings at priority ≥0.90 must block; findings at priority <0.90 must remain advisory
T10 DetGateRule must fire on terraform and GitHub Actions workflow plans but skip non-infra plans with coverage entry
